newsitem.title: USA: CME board approves cheddar cheese block futures.
newsitem.headline: CME board approves cheddar cheese block futures.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange board of directors approved earlier this week the addition of cheddar cheese block futures and options to its menu of contracts, pending approval by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

The exchange said in a statement issued Friday that the contract called for trading in 40-lb blocks of cheddar cheese (40,000 lbs total). The market will be based on cash settlement using a weekly price issued by the U.S. Department of Agriculture's National Agricultural Statistics Service.
A wholesale cheese market moved to the CME on May 1 after 41 years at the National Cheese Exchange in Green Bay.
